method: Single ordinary stdlib Path.lstat per exact source-derived path, no project import/main, no root/native/device call, no privilege/alternate-path retry. Raw tool stdout observations are encoded below; no artifact/source/lease mutation.
namespace_limit: Only current HOST path observations. No claim that a HOST namespace is interchangeable with the guest; the current guest archive map is joined separately. No absence is treated as resource retirement or permission.
source_predicate: PROGRAM=MCPS_PREFIX+/bin/mcinspect; KERNEL=--kernel=+MCPS_MCKERNELDIR+/mckernel.img; posix_spawn actual required program argv includes --ps. Qualified configured values are /usr/local and /usr/local/smp-x86/kernel.
